verdict.rationale: Riveter runs its own AI agent loops with tools such as web search, scraping and third-party API calls, so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows Riveter acting as an MCP server, which is the opposite role: a hosted endpoint at mcp.riveterhq.com and a local Node server for Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor. Nothing shows Riveter connecting to user-supplied MCP servers or using their tools.
